_comment: Wording for release announcements (Telegram and Bluesky). The header and sponsor line rotate, one per release, picked by the number of releases so far. Keep the two list lengths free of common factors (e.g. 5 and 6, or 5 and 7) so the same pair comes round as rarely as possible. {version} is replaced with the version number. Each sponsor line ends with link_text, which links to the Sponsors page.

headers.text: DigiNode Tools v{version} has been released
Time to update: DigiNode Tools v{version} is now available!

sponsor_lines.text: 💙 DigiNode Tools is free and always will be. Sponsorship gives me more time to build it, so releases like this keep coming.
💙 Enjoying DigiNode Tools? Sponsors make it possible for me to spend more time on it, including the bigger features on the roadmap.
💙 Find DigiNode Tools useful? Please support its development:
💙 I build DigiNode Tools in my spare time. Sponsorship lets me spend more of it on new features and fixes.
💙 Every sponsor, big or small, helps keep DigiNode Tools moving forward.
💙 Every DigiByte node helps keep the network decentralised. Sponsoring DigiNode Tools helps more people run one.
